scope: Current implementation audit; documentation only. This contract supersedes the earlier prompt pack's feature priorities, not its integrity constraints.

reference_basis.available_uploads: The two referenced pasted-text attachments contain the Azaeron prompt pack. No separate benchmark report or independently verified accuracy dataset was available in those references.
reference_basis.interpretation: Preserve the implemented report pattern: document identity, independent dimensions, exact evidence, source context, limitations, provenance, review and revision. Do not adopt numerical benchmark or competitor claims from the prompt pack.

classification_rules.EXISTING_AND_WORKING: Implemented and supported by the stated tests or runtime observations, within the explicitly limited scope; not a production-readiness or accuracy certification.
classification_rules.EXISTING_BUT_BROKEN: An implemented behavior conflicts with its contract, established by source inspection, a read-only probe or the live schema.
classification_rules.EXISTING_BUT_EXPERIMENTAL: Executable analysis with tested mechanics but no demonstrated general accuracy or calibrated interpretation for the intended users.
classification_rules.MISSING_AND_REQUIRED: Necessary to finish the requested journey; extend existing components where possible.
classification_rules.OPTIONAL_LATER: Not a prerequisite for this journey; requires a concrete user need before implementation.
classification_rules.REMOVE_OR_AVOID: Excluded behavior or misleading presentation; this audit does not delete code or data.

personas.student: Check a draft, understand evidence, accept responsible edits, re-check and share the report.
personas.teacher: Open a submission, inspect findings and sources, use human judgment and give feedback.
personas.professor: Review claims and integrity evidence with explicit uncertainty and preserved versions.
personas.researcher: Inspect claims, references and retrieved support, revise with attribution and re-check.

simplicity_contract: Use one document review workflow for all four personas; persona changes the starting route, not the meaning of a result.
Keep Check and Write as primary actions. Open reports, sources and graph evidence in the context of the selected document and version.
Show plain-language findings and next actions first; expose model identifiers and graph internals on demand.
Allow users to continue when a dimension is untested, abstained or unavailable. Never require an authorship baseline or institution setup to check a document.

result_contract.state_rules: Preserve the underlying abstention, missing-baseline and provider-failure reasons. Separate operational failure from absent evidence and from experimental maturity. A completed job or complete graph does not validate an analytical conclusion.
result_contract.confidence_rule: Show a probability only with applicable calibration evidence. Keep lexical scores and baseline-data adequacy as named measurements, not calibrated confidence. Unknown confidence is null; zero matches is not proof of originality.
result_contract.span_rule: Offsets must refer to the exact displayed text of the analyzed version. Preserve original bytes and explain any normalization; never reconstruct missing evidence.
result_contract.source_rule: Show actual source identity, retrieved timestamp, payload/content hash and supporting excerpt where available. Metadata alone cannot establish support; unavailable content remains UNVERIFIABLE.
result_contract.decision_rule: Similarity is overlap evidence; AI signals and style deviation do not establish plagiarism, authorship or misconduct. The human reviewer decides.

owner_resolution: Owner IDs below identify implementation components, not people. Required changes assign the same owners; proposed changes are not claims that an API already exists.

inspection.observed: Local API readiness passed; 52 OpenAPI operations; schema at 20260912_0022; 38 public tables including alembic_version; 30 tables have forced RLS. Both registered models are EXPERIMENTAL.
inspection.prior_verification: 111 backend tests and 14 browser tests passed in retained logs. All 212 files in their source manifest still match. Suites were not rerun for this documentation audit.
inspection.verification_limits: Module fixtures and mocked browser tests do not prove extraction-to-citation correctness, multi-version processing, graph traversal, safe editing or the full re-check journey. No human usability sign-off or measured detector accuracy is established.
inspection.current_pipeline: Presign -> object upload -> validate/fingerprint -> Document + DocumentVersion -> Job/Celery -> extraction/normalization -> ProcessedDocument -> AnalysisRun/detection -> similarity -> citations -> authorship without a supplied profile -> provenance -> graph -> completed job. Report GET builds a view over the graph.

EXISTING_AND_WORKING.current: Authentication, persona onboarding, personal workspace creation, validated workspace switching, tenant authorization and server upload/Write limits work within the tested foundation scope.
EXISTING_AND_WORKING.verification_requirement: Retain real PostgreSQL cross-tenant/RLS tests and live onboarding/upload/refresh/switch coverage for all shared journey surfaces.

EXISTING_AND_WORKING.current: /check aliases file upload. Presigned storage, content validation, fingerprinting, initial version creation and asynchronous first-document analysis exist; a TXT upload completed in the live browser test. PDF/DOCX/MD/HTML handlers exist, without an end-to-end correctness claim for every format.
EXISTING_AND_WORKING.verification_requirement: Preserve upload validation and tenant isolation; verify supported formats through the real extraction path, clear extraction failures and completed version-specific results.

EXISTING_AND_WORKING.current: The report API returns seven independent dimensions and exact-span highlights; document review renders normalized text, findings, explanations and filters. The live response is assembled from the graph, not the legacy IntegrityReport score columns. State correctness has a separate defect below.
EXISTING_AND_WORKING.verification_requirement: Retain seven independent dimensions, exact recorded spans and no aggregate accusation score; add real upload-to-report coverage rather than only hand-built graph fixtures.

EXISTING_AND_WORKING.current: Tenant-scoped canonical nodes and edges, idempotent materialization and orphan-finding validation exist. Graph/report GETs can materialize records; they are not strictly read-only database operations. Graph completeness describes relationships, not analytical truth.
EXISTING_AND_WORKING.verification_requirement: Retain orphan and cross-tenant rejection; verify repeated materialization, stable identities and exact source/version relationships on realistic multi-version evidence.

EXISTING_AND_WORKING.current: Version fingerprints, parent links, analysis events and authenticated JSON timeline export exist. The browser downloads that JSON. The export is a provenance snapshot, not a full integrity report or accepted revision export.
EXISTING_AND_WORKING.verification_requirement: Retain reproducible export hashes, tenant authorization and append-only historical evidence; verify the export reflects the selected analyzed version and accepted changes when the re-check loop is connected.

EXISTING_BUT_BROKEN.current: _clean_text collapses all whitespace before paragraph segmentation and citation analysis. The read-only probe turns three paragraphs into one and makes an otherwise valid References header unrecognizable. Citation tests inject multiline cleaned_text and bypass this real pipeline defect.

api.required_change: Preserve meaningful paragraph/reference boundaries and stable offsets through extraction and analysis.

EXISTING_BUT_BROKEN.verification_requirement: Process a real multiline document with in-text citations and a bibliography through the worker; assert paragraph boundaries, reference linkage, exact displayed spans and unchanged original bytes.

EXISTING_BUT_BROKEN.current: POST versions appends and queues, but processing always inserts a ProcessedDocument while the live database enforces UNIQUE(document_id), blocking a second processed version. Detection reads scalar_one_or_none without a version filter; similarity/citation APIs combine document-wide rows; graph accepts no version parameter. The frontend independently fetches latest/unpinned results. The worker also records the document fingerprint rather than the requested version fingerprint.

api.required_change: Permit immutable per-version processed results, pin every read and inference fingerprint to one version, and preserve historical evidence.

EXISTING_BUT_BROKEN.verification_requirement: Real PostgreSQL plus worker test: process v1 and v2 of one document, retry deliveries safely, read both versions independently, reject foreign version IDs and prove each source span/hash/report belongs to its requested version.

EXISTING_BUT_BROKEN.current: Report _status treats any AI/authorship nodes as EXPERIMENTAL even when their metadata says abstained or missing baseline; both are reproduced in the audit probe. The report averages positive evidence confidence values without calibration. The frontend's >=70% filter treats those values as high confidence. Detail requests catch module failures as null, and DegradedBanner only detects browser offline state.

api.required_change: Propagate underlying result and failure states; separate calibration-backed confidence from heuristic measurements.

EXISTING_BUT_BROKEN.verification_requirement: Cover absent results, actual abstention nodes, missing baseline, empty corpus, resolver outage and API failure in report/API/browser tests. Uncalibrated measurements must not become confidence percentages or satisfy a calibrated-confidence filter.

EXISTING_BUT_BROKEN.current: Write accepts arbitrary pasted text while labeling suggestions with a selected immutable version; it stores a submitted-text hash without checking it against that version. /apply changes an applied boolean only. The preview always includes all proposed edits; Reject is disabled for pending edits and rejected decisions display as Pending review.

api.required_change: Bind the editorial source to a recorded version; distinguish pending, accepted and rejected decisions and compute the accepted revision separately from the all-suggestions preview.

EXISTING_BUT_BROKEN.verification_requirement: Load the selected version into Write, reject a pending edit, accept a subset, reload the ledger and verify the resulting text. Detect stale/mismatched source text, overlapping edits and document-switch races before accepting a revision.

EXISTING_BUT_BROKEN.current: The upload UI advertises 100 MB while current server entitlements allow 10 MiB free or 50 MiB paid. Its 20/60/85/100 percentages are fixed upload milestones, not measured progress. It discards the confirmation result and routes to the document list; list/detail do not poll job completion.

api.required_change: Use server limits and the returned document/job context; show measured progress when available or truthful named stages otherwise.

EXISTING_BUT_BROKEN.verification_requirement: Browser checks for quota rejection, upload/queue distinction, worker failure and completion without manual refresh; completion must open the correct document rather than imply that upload completion is analysis completion.

EXISTING_BUT_EXPERIMENTAL.current: Tenant-local incremental lexical/ngram retrieval and deterministic span verification emit EXACT, NEAR_DUPLICATE, LEXICAL and STRUCTURAL matches, with exclusions and score components. Candidate and verification work is bounded. No web-wide corpus, active semantic/paraphrase model or demonstrated representative retrieval accuracy exists.
EXISTING_BUT_EXPERIMENTAL.verification_requirement: Use a permissioned seeded corpus to verify source/target spans, exclusions, retrieval bounds and tenant/version isolation. Label corpus coverage and heuristic scores explicitly; publish recall or performance claims only from reproducible representative measurements.

EXISTING_BUT_EXPERIMENTAL.current: Claim/citation/reference/source/finding records and Crossref DOI retrieval exist. Retrieved payloads are hashed; absent source content remains UNVERIFIABLE. Support assessment uses abstract lexical overlap, not full-text entailment. The module fixture passes, while real extraction loses bibliography structure as recorded above.
EXISTING_BUT_EXPERIMENTAL.verification_requirement: Verify the real ingestion chain, DOI failure/timeout/no-abstract cases, metadata mismatches and exact retrieved excerpts. No metadata-only support claim or fabricated source-quality score; preserve UNVERIFIABLE separately from NOT_SUPPORTED.

EXISTING_BUT_EXPERIMENTAL.current: Versioned linguistic/style/syntax and segment/document signal extraction, calibration interfaces and abstention are implemented. The default orchestrator has no classifiers and returns INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE with null confidence. The live model registry contains only experimental entries; production model accuracy is not established.
EXISTING_BUT_EXPERIMENTAL.verification_requirement: Retain no-model/uncalibrated/provider-failure abstention tests and verify the same state in the report. Any future calibrated classification requires frozen held-out data, leakage checks, subgroup/error analysis and reproducible promotion evidence; a new classifier is not required to complete this journey honestly.

EXISTING_BUT_EXPERIMENTAL.current: Baseline-relative style statistics and data-adequacy gates exist: at least three qualifying baseline documents, 500 total words, 80 words per sample and target. Missing baseline produces INSUFFICIENT_DATA; AI use is NOT_TESTED. The normal worker supplies no profile, so automatic processing does not perform a baseline comparison.
EXISTING_BUT_EXPERIMENTAL.verification_requirement: Retain insufficient-baseline and owned-document checks; exclude the target from its own baseline, pin baseline versions and label data adequacy separately from authorship probability. No identity conclusion or AI conclusion may be inferred from stylistic distance.

EXISTING_BUT_EXPERIMENTAL.current: Deterministic spacing, duplicate-word, phrase and contraction rules produce exact original/revision/reason records and a persisted ledger. There is no semantic preservation gate or learned voice model. A preserve_voice boolean and a Voice preserved label do not establish meaning or voice preservation; rules can also operate inside quotations.
EXISTING_BUT_EXPERIMENTAL.verification_requirement: Evaluate protected quotations, citations, numbers/dates, negation, qualifiers, technical terms and legitimate repetition. Flag uncertain changes for review and avoid unconditional preservation claims. Detector scores must never be the editing objective.

MISSING_AND_REQUIRED.current: Check supports file input only. Paste/direct typing is present in Write but cannot initiate Check.

api.required_change: Route pasted/typed text through the same authenticated immutable intake, using a text artifact where practical; no separate analysis engine is required.

MISSING_AND_REQUIRED.verification_requirement: Paste/type -> stored first version -> worker -> correct report, including empty input, quota errors and identical text/hash behavior to TXT upload.

MISSING_AND_REQUIRED.current: Citation findings, overlap evidence, abstention, missing baselines and graph integrity are distributed across modules. There is no unified review-status contract that includes document-level/unspanned issues; report highlights only include findings with span_text.

api.required_change: Derive an inspectable review list from existing evidence and operational states, with reason, evidence IDs, version, action and explicit missing spans. No new misconduct classifier or combined risk score.

MISSING_AND_REQUIRED.verification_requirement: Every review flag resolves to recorded evidence or an explicit operational reason. Unspanned issues remain visible; zero flags is not a clean-bill-of-integrity claim. No unsupported hidden-text/obfuscation detection claim.

MISSING_AND_REQUIRED.current: Graph UI lists up to 100 nodes and edge counts but offers no relationship traversal. Finding links open document-level module pages; sources/citations show IDs without a complete linked inspection flow. Module pages search only the first document page and may silently select another document when the requested ID is absent.

api.required_change: Use the existing graph payload for finding -> span -> source/citation/provenance inspection; retain document/version/finding context, expose truncation and fetch requested documents directly.

MISSING_AND_REQUIRED.verification_requirement: Browser test and four-persona usability review: reach the supporting evidence within three simple actions, including a document beyond the first list page. No silent context substitution, dangling links or cross-tenant source access.

MISSING_AND_REQUIRED.current: The authorship page only displays results; it cannot create/select a baseline or invoke the existing comparison API.

api.required_change: Offer optional, explicit baseline setup from owned processed samples; add only the profile retrieval/removal seams needed to manage that baseline. Keep an understandable untested state when skipped.

MISSING_AND_REQUIRED.verification_requirement: Browser/API coverage for opting in, skipping, inadequate samples, self-baseline exclusion, authorized profile selection and removal. Check remains usable without a baseline.

MISSING_AND_REQUIRED.current: There is no connected action that saves accepted edits as a child version, reprocesses it and compares its evidence with the parent. The version-upload endpoint is an existing seam, not a working Write-to-recheck loop.

api.required_change: Persist only reviewed accepted changes as a fingerprinted child version with parent and edit IDs, queue analysis idempotently and open version-pinned before/after evidence.

MISSING_AND_REQUIRED.verification_requirement: Real E2E: upload -> inspect evidence -> Write -> reject/accept subset -> review a preservation-risk case -> save child -> worker completion -> re-check -> retrieve both reports and change lineage. Retries create no duplicate revision; the parent remains unchanged.

MISSING_AND_REQUIRED.current: Full integrity-report export is absent. Document Download returns the original object; Export history downloads provenance JSON only.

api.required_change: Export the selected integrity report with evidence/source appendix, states, limitations, version/hash/model metadata and accepted-change lineage. Reuse the current report and export patterns; rendering format is an implementation choice.

MISSING_AND_REQUIRED.verification_requirement: Compare exported contents against the selected report/version; include missing-evidence states and source timestamps/hashes. Verify tenant access and a readable downloadable artifact without unsupported detection claims.

OPTIONAL_LATER.current: Evaluation, calibration and registry foundations exist.
OPTIONAL_LATER.boundary: Train/promote only after representative reproducible evidence and explicit review; an honest abstention state satisfies the current AI-signal journey.
BM25/vector/semantic providers or licensed external corpora require demonstrated corpus needs and evaluation; do not add them for competitor parity.

OPTIONAL_LATER.current: Text extraction handlers exist; language is assigned en and there is no OCR pipeline.
OPTIONAL_LATER.boundary: Scanned-document OCR, multilingual claims and original-page overlays require real user demand and extraction/offset verification.

OPTIONAL_LATER.current: Assignment/submission APIs and schema exist; admin/settings routes are adjacent to the main journey.
OPTIONAL_LATER.boundary: Bulk grading, LMS/SSO, seats, advanced administration and organizational dashboards are not prerequisites for individual teachers/professors.

OPTIONAL_LATER.current: Server entitlement stub and billing-related schema exist.
OPTIONAL_LATER.boundary: Payments, broad usage metering, webhooks and add-ons follow a demonstrated need after the document journey works.

OPTIONAL_LATER.current: Conservative rules and JSON provenance export exist.
OPTIONAL_LATER.boundary: Learned voice models, elaborate report styling and specialized export formats require usefulness and preservation evidence; start with a simple readable report.

REMOVE_OR_AVOID.rule: No bypass/stealth rewriting, detector-targeted optimization, watermark removal, Unicode/whitespace obfuscation or undetectable/0%-AI modes. Preserve the existing editorial API exclusions.
No fabricated benchmark numbers, 100% detection promises or competitor superiority claims. Passing software tests is not measured classifier accuracy.

Do not collapse similarity, AI signals, authorship, citation quality or provenance into one accusation score. Do not expose legacy score fields as validated outcomes or style adequacy as identity probability.
Correct fixed percentage progress, the 100 MB entitlement mismatch, unconditional Voice preserved language and production-looking labels for untested results. Preserve clear missing/degraded states.
No automatic misconduct, plagiarism or identity determination; show evidence and uncertainty for human review.
No decorative admin analytics, invented metrics, forced institution setup or extra persona dashboards unrelated to this journey.
Current document DELETE archives and preserves history; do not represent it as irreversible storage/index/database erasure. Full purge is not verified by the archive test.

completion_gate.required: All required capabilities meet their scoped verification requirements, including the real full-journey E2E and simple review by student, teacher, professor and researcher. Experimental modules may remain experimental; uncertainty must survive every view and export.

HIGHEST_PRIORITY_NEXT_IMPLEMENTATION.outcome: Preserve paragraph/reference structure and allow immutable processing of successive versions before connecting Write to re-check.
HIGHEST_PRIORITY_NEXT_IMPLEMENTATION.first_acceptance: Process v1 and v2 of one real cited document through PostgreSQL/Celery; both complete, keep distinct text/hash/evidence, resolve bibliography references and return their own version-pinned content and reports.
HIGHEST_PRIORITY_NEXT_IMPLEMENTATION.reason: The current pipeline loses citation structure on the first check and cannot store processed text for the second version. Later UI work would inherit both defects.
